protocol.metric: (P_X observable error + P_Z observable error)/syndrome cycles; nonconvergence is separately recorded and is not automatically an observable failure
protocol.numeric_profile: existing canonical float64 min-sum total-minus-excluded-message order; paper hard-decision tie1; source prefix/suffix is separate reference
protocol.sampling: immutable shared detector/observable chunks per code/rate/basis; independent of decoder; cache producer CPU may differ, persisted bytes are authoritative
protocol.stopping: 20 observable errors or 100M decoded shots, separately per memory basis; retain exact prefix; two bases run sequentially on one CPU
protocol.uncertainty: 97.5% exact capped inverse-binomial/binomial intervals per basis; sum bounds / cycles gives Bonferroni simultaneous coverage at least95%
